answer_1.quote: For generation tasks, we focus on generating dynamic content: Query Rewriting (QR) generates rewrites of user queries, Ad Copy Generation (AG) creates complete ad copy directly, and both Description Generation (DG) and Title Generation (TG) develop concise descriptions and titles...
answer_1.outputs: Generated ad copies, query rewrites, descriptions, titles, and title rewrites for downstream advertisement tasks.

answer_2.quote: For generation tasks, we use Chat‑GPT (OpenAI, 2022) to calculate the winning rate of TRAIT compared with the Mistral‑7B model. The evaluation metrics for QR consist of diversity (Div.) and density (Den.).

answer_3.quote: We prompt ChatGPT to choose the better answer from responses generated by our model and Mistral‑7B, swapping positions to mitigate bias.
